d:
Experience the enchanting melody "Priyathama Priyathama" from Majili! Featuring the heartfelt performances of Naga Chaitanya and Samantha, with soulful music by Gopi Sunder, this lyrical song is sure to touch your heart.
Song: Priyathama Priyathama
Movie : Majili
Banner: Shine Screens
Producers: Sahu Garapati and Harish Peddi
Story & Direction: Shiva Nirvana
Art Director : Sahi Suresh
Music: Gopi Sunder
